name: Fiserv
description: Fiserv is the back-office technology behind much of US banking and card payments. Its Financial segment runs account processing, digital banking, debit and credit card processing and prepaid cards for banks and credit unions, mostly under multi-year contracts that charge per account or per transaction. Its Merchant segment (merchant acquiring, the Clover point-of-sale platform for small businesses, enterprise payments) charges merchants a percentage of card volume plus software and hardware fees. In total 80 percent of revenue is recurring processing and services revenue. A CEO change and a guidance cut in October 2025 followed by a 44 percent one-day share drop reset the company under a 'One Fiserv' plan.

employees.note: "Over 38,000 employees worldwide" per the 10-K (a floor, not an exact count).

businessLines.name: Merchant Solutions
businessLines.how: Takes a percentage fee plus per-transaction fee on card payments processed for merchants (small businesses via Clover, large enterprises, and bank/ISO partners that resell), plus Clover software subscriptions, hardware sales and merchant cash advances (Clover Capital); revenue follows merchant sales volume.

businessLines.name: Financial Solutions
businessLines.how: Banks, credit unions and other issuers pay per account, per card and per transaction processed under multi-year contracts with high renewal rates, plus software licences, card production and professional services; revenue follows the clients' account and transaction counts.

businessLines.name: Corporate and Other
businessLines.how: Revenue from activities not part of the two segments (includes non-allocated businesses and amortisation items); the larger part of this line is unallocated corporate cost, shown as an operating loss.

brands.name: Clover
brands.note: POS and business-management platform for small businesses (hardware plus SaaS plus payments); revenue not separately disclosed in the 10-K

brands.name: Zelle
brands.note: Fiserv offers a turnkey implementation to financial institutions

brands.name: Money Network
brands.note: Prepaid payroll, government disbursement and incentive cards

brands.name: Optis
brands.note: Credit card processing platform in North America
